name: mri_knee
description: Order a knee MRI to evaluate meniscal tears, ligament injuries, cartilage defects, and internal derangement. Gold standard for sports injuries and chronic knee pain.

contrast.description: Contrast requirement — most knee MRIs are without contrast

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., ACL tear, meniscal tear, locking knee, chronic pain)

when_to_use: suspected ACL, PCL, or collateral ligament tear after knee injury
suspected meniscal tear (mechanical symptoms: locking, catching, giving way)
chronic knee pain with normal X-rays
evaluation of cartilage defects or osteochondral lesions

examples.query: Young athlete, pivoting injury, immediate swelling, positive Lachman test
